note: Every extension name each context advertises, put back through getExtension. Chrome hands back a named interface object per extension; WebGL 1 here answers undefined for 37 of 39 (a void union payload) and WebGL 2 answers [object Object] for 34 of 36 (an anonymous empty struct). getSupportedExtensions lists all of them in both arms, so the engine advertises what it then refuses. protoNames is the member set to reproduce per interface.
